messages:
Priya Menon: Quick note  candidate delayed (flight) arriving 3045m late tomorrow (Thu). Will need flexible badge pickup, a parking permit if they drive, and a dual-monitor setup for a coding task. Also requested a low-fragrance room and an ergonomic chair. Can Facilities/IT/Security help? :slightly_smiling_face:

Rowan Park: Who's the candidate and ETA? Reimbursement policy for parking?

Priya Menon: Candidate: Sandeep Rao, mobile +1-929-555-0199. New ETA 15:45 (was 15:10). If they drive, please put a one-day permit for P1. We cover parking up to $20. I'll DM the receipt process. Sandeep prefers low fragrance and needs Windows laptop (company loaner) with VS Code and Python env.

Facilities Bot: Noted. Quiet Room A (4th floor) tentatively held 15:3017:30. Ergonomic chair reserved and placed by 15:35. We'll keep room lighting low per preference.

IT Support: We have a Windows loaner available (Win11) with HDMI + DisplayPort adapters. We can pre-provision VS Code + python venv if you share pip/conda specs or a requirements.txt. Need an asset sign-out and an onsite contact to collect the laptop.

Priya Menon: Thanks IT. No special packages beyond standard python3.11 + pip. Please enable guest-wifi and create a temporary local account for candidate. I or Rowan will collect laptop at Security.

Security Desk: One-day P1 permit ready under "Sandeep Rao" if they drive. If rideshare, please advise candidate to check in at Main Lobby and we'll print badge. Badge desk staffed by Leo 15:0018:00. If flight runs later, we'll hold badge for 2 hours after ETA.

Rowan Park: I'll be onsite to greet and can pick up the laptop at 15:30. Can someone paste a short run-of-day so I can confirm schedule to Sandeep? I'll also DM the Zoom fallback in case the candidate prefers remote last-minute.

Priya Menon: Run-of-day:

15:45  Candidate arrival / badge pickup (Security)
15:55  Setup + quick systems check (IT/Rowan)
16:05  Coding exercise (60m) - dual monitor
17:10  Break (10m)
17:20  Panel wrap + Qs (25m)
17:50  Candidate departs / expense guidance

Fallback: https://zoom.redwood-inc/room-fallback

IT Support: We'll have laptop image ready and guest account cred sheet in an envelope at Security. Rowan, please initial asset sign-out when you pick it up.

Cafe Team: Low-fragrance boxed snack (apple + almond butter) and bottled water will be on the table at 15:50. If Sandeep needs a hot meal after, we can provide a vegetarian boxed dinner; please let us know by 16:30.

Priya Menon: Perfect. Security, please SMS me if the badge pickup window changes or if car permit is used. Rowan, thanks for grabbing the loaner. I'll DM Sandeep the updated ETA guidance and parking note. :thumbsup:
